name: Sample Elven Gem
summary: The Sample Elven Gem is proof of a treasure found by Shakes O’Breen’s crew. Fleet Master Seahorn in Booty Bay needs it as word of their discovery.

sections.title: A Sample for Seahorn
sections.body: Shakes O’Breen’s crew has found treasure, but low tide and watchful creatures keep them from leaving. They need you to carry the Sample Elven Gem to Fleet Master Seahorn in Booty Bay. The gem proves their find and tells Seahorn they are working to recover more.

faq.q: What is the Sample Elven Gem?
faq.answer: The Sample Elven Gem is proof of the treasure Shakes O’Breen’s crew discovered.

faq.q: Who gave me the Sample Elven Gem?
faq.answer: Shakes O’Breen provided the Sample Elven Gem for you to take to Fleet Master Seahorn.
Fleet Master Seahorn in Booty Bay needs the Sample Elven Gem as proof of the crew’s discovery.

faq.q: Why can’t Shakes O’Breen’s crew leave?
faq.answer: The tide is too low, and the creatures the crew disturbed are watching their movements.
